title: Differentiating PC12 cells to evaluate neurite densities through live-cell imaging
protocol: Sterilize wells in a 96-well plate under UV light for 30 minutes, with the lid removed.
Prepare a 50 μg/mL working PDL solution by diluting PDL stock solution (0.1 mg/mL) in sterile DPBS without calcium or magnesium.
Add 50 μL of the working PDL solution to each well.
Incubate for 1 hour at 20°C–25°C.
Wash each well three times with 100 μL cell culture grade water.
Rinse wells thoroughly to remove excess PDL solution.
Remove last wash and let wells air dry in tissue culture hood for 2 hours, with the lid removed.
Prepare a 20 μg/mL working laminin solution by diluting laminin stock solution (concentration varies) in cell culture grade water.
Add 100 μL of the working laminin solution to each well.
Wrap the plate in parafilm.
Incubate the plate for 16–24 hours at 4°C.
Thaw laminin aliquots on ice.
Prepare working laminin solution on ice.
Remove a 96-well plate from 4°C.
Incubate the 96-well plate at 20°C–25°C in a tissue culture hood for 1 hour.
Aspirate PC12 cell culture medium from cells in a T25 flask.
Wash cells with 1 mL DPBS without calcium or magnesium.
Aspirate DPBS.
Add 1 mL of 0.05% Trypsin EDTA to the cells.
Incubate the flask in a 37°C cell culture incubator with 5% CO2 for 2 minutes.
Add 1 mL of PC12 cell culture medium to the flask to inactivate trypsin.
Triturate cells 5–10 times with a P1000 pipette tip to thoroughly separate them, avoiding bubble formation.
Pass cells through a 40 μm sterile cell strainer into a 50 mL sterile centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the cells for 3 minutes at 200 × g at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate the liquid from the tube, leaving the cell pellet undisturbed.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL PC12 cell culture medium.
Transfer the PC12 cell suspension to a 1.5 mL sterile microcentrifuge tube.
Pass the PC12 cell suspension through a sterile 26-gauge syringe needle 15 times.
Count cells on a hemocytometer.
Create a 1:10 dilution of PC12 cell suspension by combining 10 μL PC12 cell suspension and 90 μL PC12 cell culture medium.
Add 20 μL to the hemocytometer.
Calculate the volume of PC12 cells required per well to achieve a plating density of 1.0 × 10^4 cells/cm² using the formula provided.
For the 96-well plates used in this protocol, use a growth area per well of 0.33 cm².
Prepare diluted PC12 cell suspension for plating.
Calculate the total volume of PC12 cell culture medium needed to plate a final volume of 100 μL per well (+ 3 extra wells).
Aliquot into a new sterile tube.
Multiply the calculated volume of cells per well by the total number of wells being plated plus 3 extra wells to determine the volume of PC12 cell suspension needed.
Remove and discard the volume calculated from the aliquot of PC12 cell culture medium.
Add the calculated volume of PC12 cell suspension to make the diluted PC12 cell suspension for plating.
Pipette up and down a few times to mix the diluted PC12 cell suspension.
Before preparing the diluted PC12 cell suspension, pipette the PC12 cell suspension up and down a few times to mix.
Wash each well one at a time by aspirating the laminin and immediately adding 100 μL of PC12 cell culture medium.
Aspirate the medium from the wells one well at a time.
Add 100 μL of diluted PC12 cell suspension to each well.
Invert the diluted PC12 cell suspension after plating every 3–6 wells.
Transfer diluted PC12 cell suspension directly into the center of each well.
Fill unused surrounding wells in the 96-well plate with 200 μl DPBS.
Transfer the 96-well plate to a 37°C incubator with 5% CO2, avoiding tilting the plate.
Prepare 25 ml stock Opti-MEM-based differentiation medium according to the recipe provided.
Filter medium through a 0.2 μm syringe filter into a new centrifuge tube.
Prepare 50 ng/ml working NGF solution in stock differentiation medium.
Perform all steps under sterile conditions in tissue culture hood.
Wait at least 2 hours after plating cells before beginning NGF treatment.
Calculate the total volume of stock differentiation medium needed for a final volume of 150 μL per well (+ 3 extra wells).
Aliquot and pre-warm the stock differentiation medium to 37°C.
Calculate the volume of NGF stock (0.1 mg/mL) to add for a final concentration of 50 ng/mL in the differentiation medium.
Remove and discard the calculated volume of pre-warmed stock differentiation medium from each aliquot.
Add the calculated volume of NGF stock to the differentiation medium.
Pipette up and down a few times to mix.
Remove PC12 cell culture medium gently by pipette and discard.
Add 150 μL working NGF solution to each well.
Tilt the plate and place the pipette tip at the edge of the well to remove media without aspirating it.
Dispense the working NGF solution slowly down the wall of the well.
Store cells in a 37°C, 5% CO2 cell culture incubator for the duration of cell culture.
Perform live-cell imaging of differentiating PC12 cells daily to quantify neurite density over time.
Set up live-cell imaging on an EVOS M7000 microscope.
Use an onstage incubator set to 37°C and 5% CO2 if imaging exceeds 20-30 minutes, and add humidity at 80% for longer than 1 hour increments.
Image a fixed region of each well immediately after NGF treatment to track differentiation over time.
Use a 20× short working distance objective.
Apply a transmitted light filter cube with phase contrast.
Capture images of 10% of each well from the center.
Set autofocus to “small structure” for optimal focus on cells and neurites.
Save data as a stitched tiled image for neurite density quantification.
Repeat step 26 every 24 hours.
Acquire images of the same fields of view.
Quantify neurite density over time.
Perform all steps under sterile conditions in tissue culture hood.
Calculate the volumes of stock differentiation medium, NGF, CultureOne, and GlutaMAX needed for a half-feed media change.
Assume reagents remaining in the media in the well are inactive/degraded.
Make up supplemented media with reagents at double the desired final concentration.
Calculate the total volume of stock differentiation medium needed for a final volume of 75 μL per well (+3 extra wells).
Aliquot and pre-warm to 37°C.
Calculate the volume of NGF stock to add to the aliquoted stock differentiation medium for a working concentration of 100 ng/mL (final concentration in each well will be 50 ng/mL).
Calculate the volume of CultureOne supplement to add to the aliquoted stock differentiation medium for a working dilution of 1:25 (final dilution in each well will be 1:50).
Calculate the volume of GlutaMAX needed for a final concentration of 4 mM in the differentiation medium.
Remove and discard calculated volumes of NGF, CultureOne, and GlutaMAX from pre-warmed stock differentiation medium.
Add calculated volumes of NGF, CultureOne, and GlutaMAX to the differentiation medium.
Pipette up and down several times to mix the supplemented differentiation medium thoroughly.
Remove 75 μL of media from each well in the cell culture plate.
Add 75 μL of the newly supplemented differentiation medium to each well.
Repeat steps involving NGF, CultureOne, GlutaMAX addition and media replacement every two days until neurite density reaches approximately 1,500 μm/mm2.
Perform western blot analysis to verify expression of neuronal proteins β-III-Tubulin, Synapsin-I, and GAP43 during differentiation process.
Fix cells once they have differentiated to a total neurite density of ∼1,500 μm/mm2 for immunocytochemistry evaluation.
Sterilize wells in 6-well plates under UV light with lids removed for 30 minutes.
Label each plate with the day that cells will be lysed.
Prepare a 20 μg/mL working laminin solution by diluting laminin stock solution in cell culture grade water.
Add 1 mL of working laminin solution to each well.
Wrap plates in parafilm and incubate for 16–24 hours at 4°C.
Mix 1.5 mL of poly-D-lysine (PDL) per well for plate coating if using non-pre-coated plates.
Plate PC12 cells at a density of 1.5 × 10^4 cells/cm² on pre-coated wells.
Add 1 mL of PC12 cell culture medium to each well after plating cells.
Add 2 mL diluted PC12 cell suspension to each well.
Fill unused surrounding wells with 2 mL DPBS.
Prepare at least 50 mL stock differentiation medium for inducing neuronal differentiation.
Add 2 mL final volume to each well for neuronal differentiation induction.
Lyse cells in "Day 0" plate.

Prepare 3.5 mL working Triton DOC lysis buffer from Triton DOC lysis buffer stock solution by adding the following reagents: 17.5 μL 1 M MgCl₂, 7 μL 0.5 M EDTA, ½ Mini, EDTA-free Protease Inhibitor Cocktail tablet, and 8.75 μL saturated Phenylmethylsulfonyl fluoride (PMSF) solution in isopropanol.
Aspirate media from the wells and wash cells with 1 mL DPBS containing calcium and magnesium.
Aspirate DPBS and add 30 μL working Triton DOC lysis buffer to each well.
Scrape the cells thoroughly in multiple directions with a mini cell scraper and transfer the lysate to a tube for sonication.
Centrifuge cell lysates briefly in a mini centrifuge.
Sonicate cell lysates using a Bioruptor® Pico device set at 4°C for 6 cycles of 30 seconds on followed by 30 seconds off.
Measure protein concentrations in cell lysates using the Bio-Rad DC Protein Assay Kit II or other suitable alternative.
Store lysates at −80°C until all cells are lysed on subsequent days before running western blot.
Optional: Aliquot lysates prior to storing at −80°C to avoid excess freeze/thaw cycles if multiple western blots need to be run.
Make aliquots in triplicate of at least 15 μg protein for each sample.
Repeat steps every 2 days to lyse cells at multiple time points during the differentiation process.
Remove and discard 1 mL of media from each well every 2 days.
Add 1 mL stock differentiation medium supplemented with NGF, CultureOne, and GlutaMAX to each well every 2 days.
Observe differentiating PC12 cells under an inverted light microscope daily to verify differentiation.
Thaw lysates on ice for SDS-PAGE preparation.
To an aliquot of 2× sample buffer stock solution, add 10% 2-Mercaptoethanol.
Prepare 1× running buffer from 10× running buffer stock solution.
Add 0.1% SDS to the 1× running buffer.
Aliquot at least 15 μg of protein from each cell lysate sample, preparing triplicate aliquots of each sample.
Add an appropriate volume of 2× sample buffer + 2-Mercaptoethanol to the lysates for a final concentration of 1× and vortex each sample.
Boil samples at 90°C–100°C for 5 min.
Vortex samples and centrifuge for 5 s in a mini centrifuge.
Load identical samples into 3 SDS-PAGE stain-free gels.
Run the gels at 120 V in 1× running buffer + SDS.
Pour stain-free gels using TGX Stain-Free™ FastCast™ Acrylamide Kit (10%).
Image gels for total protein after the dye front has left the gel.
Transfer proteins from the gels to 0.45 μm PVDF membranes in 1× transfer buffer according to standard protocol.
Incubate membranes with 5% nonfat dry milk in 1× 0.05% TBST for 1 hour at 20°C–25°C (for Synapsin-1 and GAP43).
Incubate membranes with 5% BSA in 1× 0.05% TBST for 1 hour at 20°C–25°C (for β-III-Tubulin).
Incubate membranes with Synapsin-1 primary antibody diluted in nonfat milk solution for 16–24 hours at 4°C.
Wash membranes three times for 15 minutes each in 1× 0.05% TBST.
Incubate membranes with GAP43 primary antibody diluted in nonfat milk solution for 16–24 hours at 4°C.
Wash membranes three times for 15 minutes each in 1× 0.05% TBST.
Incubate membranes with β-III-Tubulin primary antibody diluted in BSA solution for 16–24 hours at 4°C.
Wash membranes three times for 15 minutes each in 1× 0.05% TBST.
Incubate membranes with anti-Rb HRP secondary antibody diluted in nonfat milk or BSA solution for 1 hour at 20°C–25°C (depending on primary antibody).
Wash membranes two times for 15 minutes each in 1× 0.05% TBST.
Wash membranes once for 15 minutes in 1× TBS.
Develop membranes with Clarity Western ECL Substrate using a ChemiDoc or other compatible imaging system.
Quantify total protein lanes and protein bands using Image Lab software or other quantification software.
Normalize protein bands to total protein for each well.
Fix cells in paraformaldehyde (PFA).
Prepare 4% PFA in DPBS with calcium and magnesium from a 16% stock solution.
Remove and discard 75 μL media from each well.
Add 75 μL 4% PFA (final concentration = 2%) to each well.
Incubate for 10 min at 20°C–25°C.
Remove and discard all liquid from the wells.
Add 100 μL of 4% PFA to each well.
Incubate for 10 min at 20°C–25°C.
Remove and discard 4% PFA.
Wash cells once in DPBS with calcium and magnesium.
Prepare permeabilization and blocking solution containing 5% normal goat serum (NGS) + 0.3% Triton X-100 in DPBS with calcium and magnesium.
Add 100 μL of NGS/Triton X-100 solution to each well.
Incubate for 1 h at 20°C–25°C.
Prepare primary antibody solutions in DPBS with calcium and magnesium + 5% NGS.
Half of the wells will be incubated with β-III-Tubulin (Ms, 1:1000) and Synapsin-1 (Rb, 1:1000) primary antibodies.
The other half of the wells will be incubated with β-III-Tubulin (Ms, 1:1000) and GAP43 (Rb, 1:100) primary antibodies.
Remove and discard permeabilization/blocking solution from all wells.
Add 80 μL of appropriate primary antibody solution to each well.
Wrap the plate in parafilm and incubate for 16–24 h at 4°C.
Wash cells three times for 10 min in DPBS with calcium and magnesium.
Put the plate on an orbital shaker at the lowest speed during washes.
Mix Goat anti-Mouse IgG Highly Cross-Adsorbed, Alexa Fluor 594 at a dilution of 1:500 to 1:1000 in secondary antibody solution.
Mix Goat anti-Rabbit IgG Highly Cross-Adsorbed, Alexa Fluor 488 at a dilution of 1:500 in secondary antibody solution.
Remove and discard DPBS wash from the wells.
Add 80 μL of the prepared secondary antibody solution to each well.
Wrap the plate in aluminum foil to protect from light.
Incubate the plate for 1 hour at 20°C–25°C.
Wash cells three times for 10 minutes with 100 μL DPBS containing calcium and magnesium.
Wrap the plate in aluminum foil during washes on an orbital shaker at the lowest speed.
Prepare a 1:500 Hoechst dye solution in DPBS with calcium and magnesium + 5% NGS from a 1 mg/mL working stock solution.
Remove and discard the DPBS wash from the wells.
Add 80 μL of the prepared Hoechst solution to each well.
Wrap the plate in aluminum foil to protect from light.
Incubate the plate for 20 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Remove and discard the Hoechst solution from the wells.
Add 100 μL DPBS with calcium and magnesium to each well.
Image neurite-bearing cells using a fluorescence microscope equipped with a 96-well plate holder.
Use a 20× or 40× short working distance objective for imaging.
